policy_changes: At nonnegative own kill/loss cost balance, cancel voluntary Red Alert attack waves and retain local invasion defense; deficit counterattacks keep trade, armor and known-tower gates.
Recall optional forward scouts on a positive own balance; at a tie retain the existing bounded cheap warning scout.
Share terrain-screened recall across home guards, mining escorts and artillery; explicit stop cancels unsafe movement when no safe return is known.
Track defensive artillery target IDs and stop stale pursuit when a safe retarget is refused; only accepted emits change order history.
Allow short bounded productive-miner escape after fresh damage and a currently visible nearby armed threat.
Reserve power for observed Building/Defense queues and accepted construction in the current batch; never credit an unplaced generator.
Integrate the five-tank third-refinery exception with the actual protected-mining placement/resource hint and projected power.
Use one bounded current owned-team contact set for HOK defense allocation and individual danger, siege and blocker decisions; keep safe objective pressure.

limitations: No live v14 match, own replay review for v14, opponent head-to-head or tournament win-rate estimate.
Defending at nonnegative own trade balance does not reveal the opponent complete score or guarantee a win; assets break ties after trade balance.
Synthetic economy comparison omits combat, enemy economy, terrain travel, unloading congestion, ore depletion and power slowdown.
Power projection cannot see earlier submitted orders missing from the observation; runtime in-flight state is separate from the economy planner.
Initial ore and placement coordinates remain hints; actual placement and remaining ore are not guaranteed.
Combat strength and route safety are bounded heuristics; unknown enemies and threats not yet observed remain unknown.
HOK uses listed nearest-target macros; no arbitrary path, lane, target selection or hidden information is added.
No main merge, running-listener replacement or formal tournament submission was performed by this revision.
